It has also been approved that the employees who have been regularly promoted or granted financial upgradation on or after 1-1-2016 and desire to exercise I re-exercise option for pay fixation under FR 22 (I) (a) (1) shall be given an opportunity to exercise or re-exercise of the option thereunder.
